import re

CLASS = re.compile(r"^Class \[ <(?P<source>[^>]*)>(?: (?P<modifiers>.*?))? class (?P<name>\S+)(?: (?P<inheritance>(?:extends|implements) .*?))? \] \{\s*$")
SECTION = re.compile(r"^(?P<indent>\s*)- (?P<section>[A-Z][A-Za-z ]*?) \[(?P<count>\d+)\] \{\s*$")
METHOD = re.compile(r"^\s*Method \[ <(?P<source>[^>]*)>(?: (?P<modifiers>.*?))? method (?P<name>\S+) \] \{\s*$")
PARAM = re.compile(r"^\s*Parameter #(?P<index>\d+) \[ <(?P<requirement>\w+)>(?: (?P<type>[^$\s]\S*))? (?P<name>(?:\.\.\.)?&?\$\w+)(?: = (?P<default>.*?))? \]\s*$")
RETURN = re.compile(r"^\s*- (?P<kind>Tentative return|Return) \[ (?P<type>.*?) \]\s*$")
MEMBER = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<kind>Property|Constant) \[ (?P<declaration>.*?) \](?: \{ (?P<value>.*?) \})?\s*$")
CLOSE = re.compile(r"^\s*\}\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    cls, sections, methods, params, members = {}, [], [], [], []
    l_cls, l_sec, l_met, l_par, l_mem, skip = [], [], [], [], [], []
    section, method = "", None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        m = CLASS.match(ln)
        if m:
            cls = {k: v or "" for k, v in m.groupdict().items()}
            l_cls.append(j)
            continue
        m = SECTION.match(ln)
        if m:
            if method is not None and m.group("section") == "Parameters":
                method["parameters"] = int(m.group("count"))
                l_met.append(j)
                continue
            section = m.group("section")
            method = None
            sections.append({"class": cls.get("name", ""), "section": section,
                             "count": int(m.group("count"))})
            l_sec.append(j)
            continue
        m = METHOD.match(ln)
        if m:
            method = {"class": cls.get("name", ""), "section": section,
                      "source": m.group("source"), "modifiers": m.group("modifiers") or "",
                      "name": m.group("name"), "parameters": 0, "return": "", "return_kind": ""}
            methods.append(method)
            l_met.append(j)
            continue
        m = PARAM.match(ln)
        if m and method is not None:
            params.append({"class": cls.get("name", ""), "method": method["name"],
                           "index": int(m.group("index")), "requirement": m.group("requirement"),
                           "type": m.group("type") or "", "name": m.group("name"),
                           "default": m.group("default") or ""})
            l_par.append(j)
            continue
        m = RETURN.match(ln)
        if m and method is not None:
            method["return"] = m.group("type")
            method["return_kind"] = m.group("kind")
            l_met.append(j)
            continue
        m = MEMBER.match(ln)
        if m:
            members.append({"class": cls.get("name", ""), "section": section,
                            "kind": m.group("kind"), "declaration": m.group("declaration"),
                            "value": m.group("value") or ""})
            l_mem.append(j)
            continue
        if CLOSE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
    blocks = [{"name": "class", "kind": "kv", "lines": l_cls, "records": [cls]},
              {"name": "sections", "kind": "table", "lines": l_sec, "records": sections},
              {"name": "methods", "kind": "table", "lines": l_met, "records": methods},
              {"name": "parameters", "kind": "table", "lines": l_par, "records": params},
              {"name": "members", "kind": "table", "lines": l_mem, "records": members}]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
